items.question: What named Kaula determination and section does this closing statement identify?
premises: iti marks the conclusion of the fifteenth ullāsa
kaulāvalīnirṇaya is named as the work
items.inference: The colophon identifies the work as Kaulāvalīnirṇaya and the section as its fifteenth ullāsa.
uncertainties: No doctrinal claim beyond bibliographic identification is present
items.plain_english: Thus, in the Kaulāvalīnirṇaya composed by Śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsa, [this is] the fifteenth ullāsa.
